name: Weekly Meal Planning Checklist
description: A weekly checklist to plan every meal, check your calendar and build the shopping list in one sitting.

items.text: Check the fridge for items to use up this week
items.note: Plan meals around what's already nearing its use-by date.

items.text: Post the meal plan on the fridge for the family to see

faq.q: How do I plan meals for the week?
faq.a: Start by checking what you already have, then assign meals to each day around your calendar. Pick recipes that share ingredients, write them on a planner, and turn the gaps into a shopping list.

faq.q: What should I plan first, meals or the shopping list?
faq.a: Plan meals first. Once you know exactly what you'll cook, you can build a shopping list from the recipes and avoid buying random items that never become a meal.

faq.q: How can weekly meal planning save money?
faq.a: Planning reduces impulse buys, food waste, and last-minute takeout. Reusing ingredients across multiple meals and shopping a focused list keeps your grocery spend predictable.

faq.q: Can I print this weekly meal planning checklist?
faq.a: Yes. You can print the checklist or download it as a PDF, then fill in each day's meals and your shopping list by hand.

faq.q: How do I plan around a busy week?
faq.a: Check your calendar first and pencil in quick meals, leftovers, or a slow-cooker dinner on your busiest nights. Save longer recipes for evenings when you actually have time to cook.
